title: Labour and Delivery: Normal Births, Complications and Bleeding

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already open an OB kit, support a normal birth and keep the newborn warm. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Decide deliver here or go, and run a delivery calmly
  2. Handle shoulder dystocia, breech and a prolapsed cord
  3. Treat postpartum hemorrhage, and know BC's limits on oxytocin and TXA

Textbook: Chapter 42, PDF pages 3575–3628
slides.say: Welcome back. As EMRs, you've prepared an OB kit, supported a normal birth, and dried and warmed a newborn. As a PCP, you lead these calls: you decide early whether the baby will be born on scene, stay calm when something goes wrong, and treat the mother's bleeding with new tools. Today: the stages of labour and a normal delivery; the three big complications, shoulder dystocia, breech and a prolapsed cord; and bleeding after birth, including what BC lets you give.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。作为 EMR，你们已经准备过产包、协助过正常分娩、给新生儿擦干保暖。作为 PCP，你要主导这类呼叫：及早判断孩子会不会在现场出生，出状况时保持冷静，用新工具处理母亲的出血。今天讲：产程分期和正常接生；三大并发症，肩难产、臀位和脐带脱垂；以及产后出血，包括 BC 允许你用什么药。

slides.title: Labour in three stages
slides.body:
Stage 1contractions open the cervixfirst baby 8–12 h; later 6–8 h
Stage 2fully open → baby bornfirst baby 1–2 h; later about 30 min
Stage 3baby born → placenta oututerus must clamp down

Stage 2 signs: contractions every 2–3 min, urge to push, crowning.
slides.say: Labour has three stages. In the first, contractions thin and open the cervix: about eight to twelve hours for a first baby, six to eight for later ones. The waters often break near the end. The second stage runs from full dilation to the birth: one to two hours for a first baby, about thirty minutes later on. Contractions come every two to three minutes, she wants to push, and you may see crowning. The third stage runs from the birth to the placenta. Then the uterus must contract hard, because that squeezes the bleeding vessels shut.
slides.sayZh: 产程分三期。第一产程，宫缩让宫颈变薄、张开：头胎约八到十二小时，之后六到八小时；快结束时常会破水。第二产程从宫口开全到孩子出生：头胎一到两小时，之后约三十分钟。宫缩每两三分钟一次，她想用力，你可能看到着冠。第三产程从出生到胎盘娩出。之后子宫必须用力收缩，因为正是收缩把出血的血管挤闭。

slides.title: Deliver here or go?
slides.body:
• Ask: weeks, first baby, waters broken, contraction timing
  • Urge to push or move bowels: head is low; no toilet
  • Under 2 min apart, esp. not her first: birth is close
  • More than 5 min apart: usually time for a nearby hospital
  • Crowning: birth within minutes, deliver where you are
  • Time to go? Left side, clothing off below the waist, transport
slides.say: Your first decision: deliver here, or go? Ask her weeks, whether this is her first baby, whether her waters have broken, and how often contractions come. If she needs to push or to move her bowels, the head is pressing on the rectum, so keep her off the toilet. Contractions under two minutes apart, especially if she's had a baby before, mean birth is close. More than five minutes apart usually gives you time to reach a nearby hospital. Then look: crowning means birth within minutes, so deliver where you are.
slides.sayZh: 第一个决定：就地接生，还是出发？问她孕周、是不是头胎、破水没有、宫缩多久一次。如果她想用力或想大便，说明胎头正压着直肠，别让她去厕所。宫缩间隔不到两分钟，尤其不是头胎，说明快生了。间隔超过五分钟，通常来得及去附近医院。然后要看：看到着冠，几分钟内就会出生，就地接生。

slides.title: A normal delivery, step by step
slides.body:
1. Crowning: gentle palm pressure so the head doesn't burst out
  2. Support the head as it turns; never pull
  3. Sac over the face? Tear it open
  4. Nuchal cord: slip it over; too tight → 2 clamps 5 cm apart, cut
  5. Head down for the top shoulder, then up for the bottom one
  6. Babies are slippery: hold on, dry, wrap, note the time of birth
slides.say: When the head crowns, press gently with your palm so it doesn't burst out too fast. Support the head as it turns, and never pull. If the membranes cover the face, tear them. Feel around the neck for a nuchal cord, a cord wrapped around the neck. Usually it slips over the head; if it's too tight, place two clamps five centimetres apart and cut between them. Guide the head gently down for the top shoulder, then up for the bottom one. The body comes fast, and newborns are slippery, so hold on. Suction only if the airway is blocked, then dry, wrap and note the time of birth.
slides.sayZh: 胎头着冠时，用手掌轻压，防止冲出太快。胎头转动时托住，绝不牵拉。胎膜盖着脸就撕开。沿颈部摸一圈，检查有没有脐带绕颈。通常可以从头上滑过去；太紧的话，夹两把相距五厘米的夹子，在中间剪断。轻轻把头向下引导娩出上肩，再向上娩出下肩。身体出来很快，新生儿很滑，要抱牢。只有气道堵塞时才吸引，然后擦干、包好、记下出生时间。

slides.title: The cord and the placenta
slides.body:
• Breathing well: keep baby level with the placenta, wait 60–120 s
  • Needs resuscitation: clamp and cut right away
  • Clamp about 10 cm from the baby, the next 5 cm further, cut between
  • Baby's end oozing: add a clamp; don't remove the first
  • Never pull the cord. Separation: cord lengthens, gush of blood
  • Bag the placenta and bring it; don't wait on scene for it
slides.say: If the baby is breathing well, keep it level with the placenta and wait sixty to one hundred twenty seconds before cutting; held much higher, a baby can lose blood back into the placenta. If the baby needs resuscitation, clamp and cut right away. Clamp about ten centimetres from the baby, again five centimetres further, and cut between. If the baby's end oozes, add a clamp. Never pull on the cord. When the placenta separates, contractions return, the uterus firms and rises, the cord lengthens, and blood gushes. Bag the placenta, but don't wait on scene for it.
slides.sayZh: 孩子呼吸好，就让他和胎盘同高，等六十到一百二十秒再剪；举得太高，孩子的血会倒流回胎盘。需要复苏就马上夹闭剪断。在离孩子约十厘米处夹第一把，再往外五厘米夹第二把，中间剪断。孩子这端渗血就再加一把夹子。绝不要拉脐带。胎盘剥离时，宫缩再起，子宫变硬上升，脐带变长，并有一股血涌出。把胎盘装袋带走，但不要为了等它留在现场。

slides.q: The head has just delivered. The cord is wrapped tightly around the neck, and you can't slip it over the head. What do you do?
options: Pull gently on the head to deliver the shoulders quickly
Place two clamps about 5 cm apart and cut between them
Push the head back and transport urgently
Leave it and wait for the next contraction
slides.say: Quick question. The head has just delivered. The cord is wrapped tightly around the neck, and you can't slip it over the head. What do you do? A, pull gently on the head to deliver the shoulders quickly. B, place two clamps about five centimetres apart and cut between them. C, push the head back and transport urgently. D, leave it and wait for the next contraction. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来道快问快答。胎头刚娩出，脐带紧紧绕在脖子上，没法从头上滑过去。你怎么做？A 轻拉胎头，赶快娩出肩膀；B 夹两把相距约五厘米的夹子，在中间剪断；C 把胎头推回去，紧急转运；D 先不管，等下一次宫缩。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. A tight cord that won't slip over the head is clamped twice, about five centimetres apart, and cut between, so the delivery can continue. A is wrong because you never pull on the baby. C is a step for a prolapsed cord, not a nuchal cord, and only wastes time here. D is wrong because a tight cord can cut off the baby's oxygen as it comes down.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。绕颈太紧、滑不过去的脐带，要夹两把相距约五厘米的夹子，在中间剪断，分娩才能继续。A 错，绝不能拉孩子。C 是脐带脱垂的处理，不是绕颈的，这里只会浪费时间。D 错，脐带太紧，胎儿下降时可能被切断氧供。

slides.title: Shoulder dystocia: the turtle sign
slides.body:
Head out, then it pulls back tight against her

  1. McRoberts: pull her knees up toward her abdomen
  2. Firm open-hand pressure just above the pubic bone, try again
  3. Still stuck: move her onto hands and knees
  4. Still stuck: O₂ for her, keep the baby's airway, transport now

Never pull on the head. Main risk to the baby afterwards: brachial plexus injury.
slides.say: In shoulder dystocia the head is out, but the front shoulder is stuck behind the pubic bone, usually with a big baby. The head pulls back tight against her, the turtle sign. Time matters, because the chest can't expand and the cord is squeezed. First, McRoberts: pull her knees up toward her abdomen to open the pelvis. Then press firmly with an open hand just above the pubic bone and try again. Next, move her onto hands and knees. If the baby still won't come, give her high-flow oxygen, keep the baby's airway clear, and transport now.
slides.sayZh: 肩难产是胎头已出，但前肩卡在耻骨后面，多见于大个子孩子。胎头被紧紧缩回贴着产妇，叫「乌龟征」。时间很关键，因为胸廓张不开，脐带也被挤压。第一步，McRoberts：把她的双膝拉向腹部，打开骨盆。然后在耻骨上方用掌心用力按压，再试。接下来让她双手双膝着地。孩子还出不来，就给她高流量氧，保持孩子气道通畅，立即转运。

slides.title: Breech and other presentations
slides.body:
• Not head first? Best born in hospital
  • Arm, foot, face or brow first: don't try to deliver; go fast
  • Breech already coming: hands off, support the body, let it hang
  • Nape hairline visible: lift the body by the ankles toward her belly
  • Head not out in 3 min: a V of two fingers beside the nose
  • Still stuck: hips raised, hold that airway, rapid transport
slides.say: Any baby not coming head first belongs in hospital. If an arm, a foot, the face or the brow comes first, don't try to deliver; go fast. A breech, or buttocks-first, birth is about four percent of deliveries, often found only at crowning. Keep your hands off: support the body and let it hang so the head descends. When the hairline at the nape shows, lift the body by the ankles toward her abdomen. If the head isn't out in three minutes, the baby can suffocate: make a V with two gloved fingers beside the nose and push the vaginal wall off the face. Still stuck? Raise her hips, hold that airway, and go.
slides.sayZh: 凡不是头先出的孩子，都应在医院出生。先出来的是手、脚、脸或额头，不要尝试接生，快速转运。臀位，即屁股先出，约占分娩的百分之四，常到着冠才发现。手别乱动：托住身体，让它下垂，帮助胎头下降。看到后颈发际线时，握住脚踝把身体向她腹部方向抬起。三分钟内头还没出来，孩子可能窒息：戴手套用两指在鼻子两侧撑成 V 形，把阴道壁从脸上推开。还是卡住？垫高她的臀部，保持这个气道，出发。

slides.title: Prolapsed cord: take the pressure off
slides.body:
Cord first → each contraction squeezes off the baby's oxygen

  1. Hips as high as possible (pillows, or knee-chest)
  2. High-flow O₂; pant through contractions
  3. Two gloved fingers push the baby, not the cord, up off the cord
  4. Partner covers the cord with saline-moist dressings
  5. Keep your hand there all the way to hospital
slides.say: A prolapsed cord comes out before the baby, in about one to three percent of deliveries. Each contraction presses the cord against the pelvis and cuts off the baby's oxygen, so your job is to take the pressure off. Raise her hips as high as you can, or use a knee-chest position. Give high-flow oxygen and have her pant instead of pushing. With two gloved fingers, push the presenting part of the baby, not the cord, up until it stops pressing the cord. Your partner covers the cord with saline-moist dressings. Keep your hand there all the way to hospital.
slides.sayZh: 脐带脱垂是脐带比孩子先出来，约占分娩的百分之一到三。每次宫缩都把脐带压在骨盆上，切断孩子的氧供，所以你的任务是解除压迫。把她的臀部尽量垫高，或用膝胸位。给高流量氧，让她哈气而不是用力。戴手套用两指把孩子的先露部位往上推，推孩子不推脐带，直到不再压着脐带。搭档用生理盐水浸湿的敷料盖住脐带。你的手一直保持在那里，直到医院。

slides.title: Postpartum hemorrhage
slides.body:
More than 500 mL in the first 24 hours

  • Causes: soft, tired uterus (atony), tears, retained placenta
  • Also: full bladder, many past births, twins, clotting problems
  • Fundal massage: firm circular kneading over the uterus
  • Baby to the breast: suckling helps the uterus contract
  • Firm pressure on bleeding tears; pad over the vagina
  • No internal exam, no packing. Transport without delay
slides.say: Postpartum hemorrhage means losing more than five hundred millilitres in the first twenty-four hours after birth. Anything that stops the uterus contracting promotes it: a tired uterus after a long labour or twins, retained placenta, a full bladder, many previous births, or a clotting problem. Tears bleed too. Your hands come first. Massage the fundus, the top of the uterus, firmly in circles until it feels hard. Put the baby to the breast; suckling releases the mother's own oxytocin. Press on bleeding tears and place a pad. Never examine inside or pack the vagina, and transport without delay.
slides.sayZh: 产后出血是分娩后二十四小时内失血超过五百毫升。凡妨碍子宫收缩的都会促成它：长产程或双胎后子宫疲软、胎盘残留、膀胱充盈、多次生产或凝血问题。撕裂伤也会出血。先用你的双手：在宫底，也就是子宫顶部，用力画圈按摩，直到变硬。让孩子吃奶，吸吮会让母亲自己释放缩宫素。按压出血的撕裂处，放好垫子。绝不内检、绝不填塞阴道，并立即转运。

slides.q: Fifteen minutes after a home birth, the mother has soaked several pads. Her uterus feels soft. HR 124, BP 84/50. You're the PCP. What is the best plan?
options: Give oxytocin 10 units IM, then massage the fundus
Fundal massage, baby to breast, O₂, keep warm, go; IV en route, 20 mL/kg up to 2 L
Pack the vagina with gauze, then start transport
Stay on scene until 2 L of saline has run in
slides.say: Now a PCP decision. Fifteen minutes after a home birth, the mother has soaked several pads, and her uterus feels soft. Heart rate one twenty-four, blood pressure eighty-four over fifty. You're the PCP. Best plan? A, oxytocin ten units IM, then fundal massage. B, fundal massage, baby to the breast, oxygen, warmth, and go, with an IV en route at twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres. C, pack the vagina, then transport. D, stay on scene until two litres of saline have run in. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。家中分娩十五分钟后，产妇已湿透好几片垫子，子宫摸起来软。心率一百二十四，血压八十四比五十。你是 PCP，最好的方案？A 肌注缩宫素十单位，再按摩宫底；B 按摩宫底、孩子吃奶、给氧、保暖、出发，途中开静脉，每公斤二十毫升、最多两升；C 填塞阴道，再转运；D 留在现场，等两升生理盐水输完。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. Massage and breastfeeding help the uterus contract, and her shock fits the BC hypovolemia protocol: IV en route, twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred. A is wrong: oxytocin is not in BC EMR or PCP scope. C is wrong: never pack the vagina. D is wrong twice: fluids go en route, and you reassess every five hundred millilitres.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。按摩和哺乳帮助子宫收缩，她的休克符合 BC 低血容量流程：途中开静脉，每公斤二十毫升、最多两升，每五百毫升复评。A 错，缩宫素不在 BC 的 EMR 或 PCP 范围内。C 错，绝不能填塞阴道。D 错两处：补液在途中进行，而且每五百毫升就要复评。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: bleeding after birth
slides.body:
BC Hypovolemia protocol: hypovolemia + systolic < 90 + other signs of shock

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Control external bleeding
  • Position supine to support BP
  • Keep warm, prevent heat loss
  • O₂ to SpO₂ ≥ 94%; high flow in shock

PCP adds (en route or if delayed)

  • Vascular access (IV)
  • Bolus 20 mL/kg, max 2 L
  • Reassess every 500 mL
  • Consider TXA: read the monograph wording
slides.say: The BC hypovolemia protocol applies when she has lost a lot of blood, her systolic is under ninety, and she has other signs of shock. Every licence level controls external bleeding, lays her supine to support the blood pressure, keeps her warm, and gives oxygen, high flow in shock. Once the baby is out, lying flat is fine again, because the uterus no longer sits on the vena cava. The PCP column is new: en route, start an IV, give twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, and reassess every five hundred. The protocol also says consider TXA; we'll check the monograph's exact wording shortly.
slides.sayZh: BC 低血容量流程适用于：她失血很多、收缩压低于九十、并有其他休克征象。所有执照级别都要控制外出血、让她仰卧支持血压、保暖、给氧，休克时用高流量。孩子生出来后，平躺又没问题了，因为子宫不再压着下腔静脉。PCP 一栏是新的：途中开静脉，每公斤二十毫升、最多两升，每五百毫升复评。流程还写了考虑 TXA，我们稍后核对药物专论的原文。

slides.title: Trauma in pregnancy
slides.body:
• You can only treat the baby through the mother
  • Left side, or tilt the board 30° left
  • Baby can be in shock while her vitals look normal: treat early
  • Fetal heart: normal 120–160; normal ≠ unhurt
  • Every injured pregnant patient goes to hospital
  • Arrest: CPR as usual; one rescuer pushes the uterus left
slides.say: Trauma is the leading cause of maternal death, and you can only treat the baby through the mother. Transport her on her left side, or tilt the spine board thirty degrees left. Her body shunts blood away from the baby to protect herself, so the fetus can be in shock while her vital signs still look normal. Treat shock early: for a PCP, that's the hypovolemia protocol, and TXA within its BC limits. A normal fetal heart rate doesn't prove the baby is unhurt, so every injured pregnant patient goes to hospital. In cardiac arrest, do CPR as usual while one rescuer pushes the uterus to the left.
slides.sayZh: 创伤是孕产妇死亡的首要原因，而你只能通过母亲来救胎儿。让她左侧卧转运，或把脊柱板向左倾斜三十度。她的身体会把血从胎儿那里调走保护自己，所以她的生命体征看起来还正常时，胎儿可能已经休克。要及早处理休克：对 PCP 来说就是低血容量流程，以及在 BC 限制内使用 TXA。胎心正常不能证明胎儿没受伤，所以凡是受伤的孕妇都要送医院。心搏骤停时照常做 CPR，同时由一人把子宫推向左侧。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Never pull the cord: it can turn the uterus inside out
  • Inverted uterus: fast shock; leave an attached placenta alone
  • Small first baby or a still-large belly: expect a twin
  • Sudden breathlessness or chest pain after birth: think PE
  • Up to 500 mL after birth can be expected: trend pads and pulse
  • Fluids by protocol: reassess every 500 mL; never stay for the IV
slides.say: New watch-outs. Never pull the cord to speed up the placenta; pulling, or pressing too hard on the fundus, can turn the uterus inside out. This uterine inversion is very painful and causes shock fast, and you don't peel off a placenta that's still attached. A small first baby or a still-large belly means expect a twin, usually within thirty to forty-five minutes. Sudden breathlessness, chest pain or fainting after birth suggests a pulmonary embolism. Up to five hundred millilitres after a normal birth can be expected, so trend the pads, the pulse and her mental status.
slides.sayZh: 新的注意事项。绝不要为了加快胎盘娩出去拉脐带；拉脐带或按压宫底太用力，都可能把子宫翻出来。子宫内翻非常痛，休克来得很快，仍附着的胎盘不要去剥。第一个孩子偏小或肚子还很大，要想到双胎，第二个通常在三十到四十五分钟内出生。产后突然气促、胸痛或晕倒，要想到肺栓塞。正常分娩后出血最多五百毫升属于预期范围，所以要追踪垫子、脉搏和神志的变化。

slides.title: For the BC exam: oxytocin, TXA, CPR
slides.body:
• Oxytocin: not in BC EMR/PCP scope
  • TXA (PCP): major trauma after the hypovolemia protocol starts
  • TXA also: shock + signs of hidden or ongoing bleeding
  • TXA stops: allergy, > 3 h after injury, age < 12, isolated TBI
  • 2 g IV push over 1 min; PPH appears only as a consideration
  • Maternal arrest: adult CPR 30:2, pauses < 5 s
slides.say: Now the book versus BC. The book gives oxytocin, ten units IM or in an IV bag; it is not in BC EMR or PCP scope. TXA is a BC PCP drug, so know its monograph. The listed indications are major trauma once the hypovolemia protocol has started, and signs of shock with a mechanism or findings suggesting hidden or ongoing bleeding. It's contraindicated with allergy, more than three hours since injury, age under twelve, or an isolated head injury. The dose is two grams IV push over one minute. The book cites a trial where TXA cut deaths from postpartum hemorrhage; the BC monograph lists it only under considerations. Maternal arrest: adult CPR, thirty to two.
slides.sayZh: 现在对比原书和 BC。原书给缩宫素，十单位肌注或加入输液袋；它不在 BC 的 EMR 或 PCP 范围内。TXA 是 BC 的 PCP 药物，要熟悉它的专论。列出的适应证是：已启动低血容量流程的重大创伤；以及有休克征象，且受伤机制或体检提示隐匿或持续出血。禁忌证是过敏、受伤超过三小时、未满十二岁或单纯颅脑外伤。剂量两克静脉推注，一分钟推完。原书引用一项试验，TXA 降低了产后出血死亡；BC 专论只把产后出血列在「考虑事项」里。孕妇心搏骤停：成人 CPR，三十比二。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Decide early: urge to push, contractions < 2 min, crowning → deliver here
  2. McRoberts; breech: hands off, 3 min; cord: push the baby, not the cord
  3. PPH > 500 mL: massage, breastfeed, IV en route by protocol; no oxytocin in BC scope

Next: Chapter 43, Neonatology
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: decide early; an urge to push, contractions under two minutes apart, or crowning means you deliver where you are. Two: the complications. Shoulder dystocia: McRoberts, then pressure above the pubic bone. Breech: hands off, and watch the three-minute clock. Prolapsed cord: push the baby, not the cord, with the hips high. Three: postpartum hemorrhage is more than five hundred millilitres. Massage the fundus, put the baby to the breast, and as a PCP run the hypovolemia protocol en route; oxytocin is not in BC scope. Next, Chapter 43: the newborn. If anything was unclear, tap Ask.
slides.sayZh: 记住三件事。一，及早判断：想用力、宫缩间隔不到两分钟或看到着冠，就地接生。二，并发症：肩难产先 McRoberts，再耻骨上按压；臀位手别乱动，盯住三分钟；脐带脱垂推孩子不推脐带，臀部垫高。三，产后出血是超过五百毫升：按摩宫底、让孩子吃奶，作为 PCP 在途中按低血容量流程处理；缩宫素不在 BC 范围内。下一章，第四十三章：新生儿。有不懂的点「Ask」。
